draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.12, the 113th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 8th of 10 at QB. He went 66th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (113th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Colin Kaepernick. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (81st percentile), broad jump (85th percentile). College production: 2,282 passing yards in 2020, 7th of 10 QBs in his class with stats.
